description: This file is a PHP class file defining a controller for the admin logout functionality in OpenCart, extending from a base system controller and containing a method that logs out the user and redirects them to the login page.

classes.name: Logout
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling logout operations in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Logs out the current user, unsets session data related to user token, and redirects to the login page.
